test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment.**

The company was__ **known for its deserving respect or admiration business practices and honest and fair ethical standards**__.
solution: The correct answer is **"honourable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Honourable"** means deserving of respect or admiration. (सम्‍मानजनक; सम्‍मानपूर्ण) • **Example**: *He is an **honourable**__ person.* • It is the most appropriate one-word substitute for the phrase **"deserving respect or admiration."** • It is also a grammatically correct option, as it fits the context of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "decent",** means conforming to accepted standards of morality or respectability. It is not as strong as "honourable". (शालीन; उचित, उपयुक्त) • **Option 3, "respectable",** means considered to be socially acceptable or successful. It does not necessarily imply ethical standards. (सम्‍मान-योग्‍य, आदरणीय (समाज में अच्‍छा, उचित या सही माना जाने वाला)) • **Option 4, "trustworthy"**, means deserving of trust or confidence. It is related to honesty, but does not cover all aspects of the original phrase. (विश्‍वास-योग्‍य, विश्‍वसनीय, भरोसेमंद) 31:Tb52, The correct answer is **"excitable."**
